notes: Terminal: a small Alpine Linux (bash, git 2.45, busybox) boots inside the app on the v86 emulator; nothing to install, works on Mac, iPad and iPhone, and offline after the first start (about 10 MB, then files load as they are used)
Git lessons: Practise in the terminal sets up the lab's broken repository in one tap; Check my fix shows each check with ✓ or ✗ and ticks the Git step on your plan
Phones: a key row for Tab, Ctrl-C, Esc and the arrow keys
Terminal is in the menu; the Linux keeps running while you move around the app
Built without Docker from Alpine packages (tools/vm/, licences in vm/README.md)
Test: boot, set up Git lab 1, type the fix in the shell, Check passes and the step ticks
